reviews.notes: Round 1 @49bd91df (whole branch): 9 findings. Both fixed in 4a22a58a: each of the three eval failures is now attributed separately, with dates-happy-en-01 recorded as flaky (1 of 3 runs) and the explicit caveat that n=3 here vs n=1 at base cannot rule out a raised flip rate.
